observed.caption: Aerial twilight view of a wide city avenue lined with high-rise buildings and trees extending toward the horizon.
observed.description: The photo shows a wide urban avenue running from the foreground to the distant background, flanked on both sides by tall high-rise buildings with varied facades and numerous windows. The left side features a dark tall building with a large vertical advertisement and an adjacent brown tower, while the right side has a cluster of light and brown towers. A low white building with a reddish roof sits in the foreground center. The avenue contains small vehicles with visible headlights and is bordered by dense dark green trees and open park areas. In the middle distance a blue rectangular billboard structure spans near the road, and a solitary white high-rise stands beyond the tree line. The sky above is pale blue fading to bright near the horizon with scattered clouds, and distant hills are faintly visible under soft twilight lighting.
